detail.longDescription: "Free access is worthless when the binding constraint is not access but attention, and attention is allocated by brand. To be honest, we are already seeing that trend and AI will only accelerate. We will have open archives that nobody reads and closed reputational cartels that everybody does. That is a worse settlement than the one we are leaving, and it would be dishonest to present it as an equilibrium anyone should welcome."—Giorgio Gilestro The Weimar of knowledge > https:// giorgio.gilest.ro/the-weimar-o f-knowledge/ # AI_generated_research # access # techno_feudalism # arXiv # intellectual_capacity # data # open_source_hardware # open_acquisition_software # open_raw_data # institutional_press # methodological_detail # closed_reputational_cartels # peer_review # physics # research # medicine # biology # chemistry # brand # research_papers # archives # reputation # reward # rent # paywalls # gatekeepers # attention # unusable
